translations.web: No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with evil.
translations.bsb: No harm befalls the righteous, but the wicked are filled with trouble.
translations.kjv: There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.
